description_en: Associates a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance with a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
description_zh: 调用BindSmartAccessGateway接口将智能接入网关绑定到指定的云连接网中。
kebab_example: aliyun smartag bind-smart-access-gateway --ccn-id ccn-isdjvvkexkrpk00000 --smart-ag-id sag-m7ez44zpayma00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-uid 1250123456123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindSmartAccessGateway

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance with which you want to associate the SAG instance
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关的所属区域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例的用户ID
parameters.name: smart_ag_uid
